label: Right after a distance in kilometres or miles (or a km/h-mph speed), the slot where its conversion goes: the opening bracket, slash or ', or' and the first digits of the converted number, e.g. a ride of 14 km (9 miles); the bracket fires even when no conversion follows it. Weaker (about 0.3-0.5) after other measures: kilograms, metres/feet, hectares, nautical miles, and 'pounds' even as money. Quiet for temperature, litres, plain money, a bracket after a count of people or after an ordinary word, and a distance with no bracket after it.
